violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: uncooked salmon filet stored above canned drinks and bag of salad mix on shelf inside the Hoshizaki 3 Dr UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated canned drinks and bag of salad mix to the top shelf inside the Hoshizaki 3 Dr UR refrigerator.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: glasses cleaned in chlorine sanitizer solution glass cleaner with 0ppm concentration in the bar area.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: CFM will discontinue using chlorine dish machine until repaired and chlorine sanitizer solution is between 100-200 ppm per manufacture instruction and will clean/ sanitize glasses using the high temperature dish machine in main kitchen.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Inside the holder for the ice scoop are not being cleaned as required (full of dirty standing water) next to the ice machine (main kitchen).
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. CDI: CFM discarded dirty water in ice scoop holder and washed/rinsed/sanitized before replacing near the ice machine in main kitchen.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: diced roasted potatoes (50F) and cooked sautéed sliced zucchini (46F) inside Continental 2 Dr/ DWR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM discarded diced roasted potatoes and sautéed zucchini.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: no asterisk next tuna tartare, smoked salmon, burgers, ribeye/ NY/ filet mignon steaks, salmon filet on printed and online food menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. EHS scheduling follow up for updated menu included reminder (asterisk) next to the following items: tuna tartare, smoked salmon, burgers, ribeye/ NY/ filet mignon steaks, salmon filet on printed and online food menu.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials (two chemical spray bottles) are not properly labeled with a common name (quat sanitizer solution) on shelf near the 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CFM labeled the two chemical spray bottles with common name (quat sanitizer solution)

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple squeeze bottles (water, oil, chili oil, various sauces) and dry seasoning/ spices (salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, paprika) plastic containers throughout main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: CFM placed label with common food name on squeeze bottles (water, oil, various sauces) and dry seasoning/ spices (salt, pepper, paprika) plastic containers. EHS instructed CMF to label all food items removed from original container with common food name.

violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: CFM placed hand soap at the hand sinks near the 3 vat sink and bar area.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 180F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 180F.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. CDI: CFM scheduled repair on high temperature sanitizer dish machine. CFM has agreed to use 3 vat sink to washed, rinsed, and sanitized (quat sanitizer solution: 200ppm) kitchen equipment and utensils until high temperature dish machine is repaired.

violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: various steaks (NY strip steak, ribeye, etc), ceviche (lime marinated shrimp), salmon filet.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored above RTE basil leaves, salad mix, and cooked half chicken inside Hoshizaki 3 Dr UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated shelled eggs to bottom shelf inside the walk in refrigerator.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: uncooked chicken (half of whole chicken) stored above uncooked beef inside True 1 Dr UP refrigerator (downstairs).
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CDI: CFM relocated uncooked chicken to bottom shelf up the UP refrigerator.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: sushi rice not time stamped for 4 hour discard time.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: Time marked the sushi rice for 3 1/2 time stamp discard. Will cooked one more batch of sushi rice until closing time.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: uncooked salmon and shrimp thawing in container of standing water near the front of the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: CFM relocated salmon and shrimp to walk in refrigerator to properly thaw under refrigeration.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: debris/ standing cloudy water on the interior of the ice scoop holder near ice machine in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CDI: CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized ice scoop holder.
